correctness.rationale: For every integer ell>=0 the fixed-order hemisphere matrix is 2x2 with diagonal 1/2. The associated Legendre Sturm–Liouville Wronskian evaluates off-diagonal coefficients as exact central-binomial products; strict log-convexity and log-concavity and a common Wallis limit prove inter-order separation and unique optimal order. An exact adjacent-ell ratio yields the all-degree bound and asymptotics. Independently constructed quadrature tests support but do not substitute for the proof.
